items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 preserves cause-and-extent assessment cover under §5.2.6(b) even for gradual leakage. An ordinary inspection and findings allowance of €300 gross is below the €3,000 event cap.

items.description: Indoor leak detection, technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(a), (c) cover leak location, technician time and one vehicle charge. Estimate €420 gross for detection and technician time plus €75 gross for travel, below the respective limits of €1,000 and €83.30 gross.

items.description: Linoleum and skirting removal, screed preparation and disposal
items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 excludes removal, preparation and disposal for moisture damage caused by gradual porosity. No pipe-access work is separately identified, so the expected payment is zero; the positive estimate is conditional on the whole line being accepted.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes provisioning for the contractor's personnel. The conditional figure is €15 gross per serving for three servings; expected payment is zero.

Section 7.1.10 bars §7.1.7 drying and disinfection for moisture damage from gradual pipe porosity, including the labour and dust protection bundled into this line. The positive figure is a conditional lump-sum estimate for the whole scope; expected payment is zero.

Section 7.1.10 excludes the underlying drying, and §7.1.7 independently treats electricity as included in a drying lump sum. The conditional figure is 2,412.1 kWh at about €0.33 gross per kWh; expected payment is zero.
